title: Alert
summary: Full-width status surface for page-level state - saved, failed, queued.

title: Auth layout
summary: Centered card on a tile-pattern backdrop - sign-in, sign-up, password reset.

title: Avatar
summary: User mark - image, initials fallback, optional online/away status dot.

title: Badge
summary: Inline status chip - sparingly. Max 2 per row.

title: Breadcrumb
summary: Hierarchical trail with the current page marked via aria-current.

title: Button
summary: The workhorse. 3px square border, inverted fill on primary, no shadow.

title: Callout
summary: Inline sidebar for curriculum notes, tips, and cautions.

title: Card
summary: Flat bordered container. Grid-friendly. No shadow, no hover lift.

title: Checkbox
summary: Flat, square, accent-filled checkmark.

title: Close button
summary: Inline dismiss affordance - modals, alerts, drawers.

title: Combobox
summary: Typeahead select. Filters as you type.

title: Command palette
summary: ⌘K spotlight - global commands, grouped, keyboard-shortcut hinted.

title: Data table
summary: Sortable, selectable, paginated table - header sort buttons, optional row select.

title: Description list
summary: Term + detail metadata pair - stacked or inline layout.

title: Divider
summary: Hairline rule. Solid or dashed; horizontal or vertical.

title: Dropdown
summary: Menu anchored to a trigger - overflow actions, filters, sort.

title: Empty state
summary: No-data placeholder with title, description, and a primary action.

title: Fieldset
summary: Groups related controls under a legend - required for radio groups.

title: Form control
summary: Low-level text control - no label wrapper, for custom layouts.

title: Form group
summary: Groups a label, control, and help text with consistent spacing.

title: Form stepper
summary: Multi-step form progress - keyboard navigable.

title: Heading
summary: Headline primitive - independent of HTML level. Five visual sizes; tag chosen for outline.

title: Help block
summary: Field-level guidance - neutral, success, or error tone.

title: Hotspots
summary: Clickable regions overlaid on a background image or diagram. Quiz mode with target, feedback, and hints.

title: Image
summary: Responsive image wrapper with built-in aspect caption and alt enforcement.

title: Input
summary: Text input with a built-in label, helper text, and error slot.

title: Link
summary: Inline links carry the highlight accent and thicken on hover.

title: Listbox
summary: Persistent selection list - keyboard navigable, single or multi-select.

title: Modal
summary: Blocking dialog - confirmations and short-form destructive choices.

title: Navbar
summary: Top app bar - three-zone (start / center / end), theme-flat, no shadow.

title: Pagination
summary: Page selector - Ark UI pagination machine, keyboard navigable.

title: Panel
summary: Borderless surface-two container - sidebars, inspectors, nested regions.

title: Radio
summary: Mutually exclusive choice - group with `name` or `radio-group`.

title: Select
summary: Native select wrapper - square chevron, matching height with Input.

title: Sidebar layout
summary: Header + left rail + main - the curriculum chrome shape.

title: Sidebar
summary: Left rail - sections + items, optional collapsible groups.

title: Skeleton
summary: Placeholder bars during data fetch - reduced-motion aware shimmer.

title: Spacer
summary: Explicit whitespace on an 8-step scale.

title: Stacked layout
summary: Header + main + footer - the marketing/news chrome shape.

title: Switch
summary: For settings that take effect immediately - theme, audio, keybinds.

title: Table
summary: Rule-heavy, square, mono-numeric - for progress and diagnostic data.

title: Tabs
summary: Inverted-fill selected state, matches the platform editor panel.

title: Text
summary: Body-text primitive - semantic-tag agnostic, size + weight + tone variants.

title: Textarea
summary: Multi-line text control with mono variant for code snippets.

title: Tile matcher
summary: Data-driven memory / matching game for interactive curricula. Flip to reveal, match pairs, fire callbacks.

title: Toast
summary: Transient status surface - Ark UI toaster machine, reduced-motion aware.

title: Toggle button
summary: For stateful binary choices - hours pressed, unit selected, dark mode on.

title: Tooltip
summary: Contextual hint on hover or focus - keep to 80 chars.
